hero.badge: Strategic IT Consulting Boutique & Software Engineering
hero.subtitle: We turn complex ideas into practical solutions. From process modeling to the cloud, we structure custom systems for companies that need to optimize costs, ensure resilience, and scale with full control.

painPoints.title: The pain points blocking digital evolution — and how we address each one.
painPoints.subtitle: We act where the impact is financial and operational: cost, security, standardization, and technical continuity.

cards.title: High Costs and Lack of Cloud Control
cards.description: Growing invoices, oversizing, and lack of financial visibility over cloud environments.

cards.title: Security Risks and Downtime
cards.description: Vulnerabilities, lack of monitoring, and exposure of critical assets to the market.

cards.title: Rigid Systems and Lack of Standardization
cards.description: Processes without architectural modeling (UML), generating rework and vendor lock-in.

cards.title: Unaligned Technical Teams
cards.description: Teams with fragmented skills, low productivity, and difficulty evolving technologically.

cards.title: Infrastructure Without Continuity Plan
cards.description: Fragile operations without structured Disaster Recovery (DR) or defined RTO/RPO.

cards.title: Vendor Lock-in and Loss of Sovereignty
cards.description: Excessive reliance on cloud providers without real data and application portability.

methodology.title: The TriggleSys Method
methodology.subtitle: We combine European methodical planning with agile execution to transform your infrastructure end-to-end.

steps.title: 1. Predictive Diagnosis (Nordic Rigor)
steps.description: We analyze your current infrastructure to identify processing waste (oversizing) and vulnerabilities. We map risks before they affect your budget or operations.

steps.title: 2. Sovereignty & Resilience Architecture
steps.description: We design a custom operation based on Zero Trust and Zero Downtime. We ensure your company has total freedom to migrate data with native compliance (LGPD/GDPR).

steps.title: 3. Efficient Implementation & FinOps
steps.description: We execute the migration or optimization focusing on balance: drastic reduction of computational costs (FinOps) aligned with sustainable IT practices (Green IT).

steps.title: 4. Educational Staff Augmentation
steps.description: We don't just deliver the project, we eliminate your team's ramp-up time. We allocate technical professionals and educators who mentor your internal team.

qualifications.title: Certified Excellence & Compliance
qualifications.subtitle: Our commitment to global standards and continuous education ensures top-tier delivery and risk mitigation.

items.title: Oracle Java Certified Professionals
items.description: Highly qualified and globally recognized team in software engineering and educational staff augmentation.

items.title: LGPD & GDPR Ready

items.title: ISO 27001 / 27701 Alignment
items.description: Strict information security and privacy controls applied from diagnosis to final delivery.

items.title: Zero Trust Architecture & UML
items.description: Advanced modeling (Enterprise UML) and security by design for critical, zero-downtime infrastructures.

items.title: FinOps & Green IT
items.description: Cloud cost optimization combined with sustainable practices, combatting computational oversizing.
